## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and angular woman with a gaunt figure, sallow cheeks, and hard, work-worn hands. Her dark hair, which has grown increasingly gray over time, is tightly twisted behind her head in a hard little knot secured with two hairpins. As a very small child, she was described as a dark, homely little thing.

## Personality

A self-contained, sensible woman of narrow experience, she possesses a rigid conscience and a strict devotion to what she perceives as her duty. Characterized as practical, non-imaginative, and stern, she values neatness and order, detests cats, and firmly disapproves of displaying deep emotion. Despite her unsympathetic and often sarcastic demeanor—particularly when suffering from headaches or after a moment of self-betrayal—she is known to have mellowed over time. She refuses on principle to criticize ministers in any form, proves cautious and deliberate when making decisions, and is noted for her skill in making braided mats and celebrated homemade currant wine. When raising a child, she favors moral lessons and inexorable discipline, conceiving it her duty to instill a tranquil uniformity of disposition. Deep down, nothing in her life brings her greater happiness than knowing [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is going to marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for sixty years, having grown up in the home built during her youth alongside her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). In her childhood, she heard an aunt call her a dark, homely little thing and was raised under traditional discipline rules where children were expected to keep still. When [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brought orphan [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by mistake, Marilla was initially shocked and intended to return her, but she reconsidered upon learning of Anne's past hardships and seeing her distress at the prospect of living with Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md). Marilla resolved to raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) properly and educated her, although she often found herself exasperated by Anne's imaginative theatricality, such as when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green and Marilla had to cut it off. During a long recovery after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) broke her ankle, Marilla realized how deeply she cared for the girl. As time passed, Marilla agreed to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join Miss Stacy's advanced class, supported her through Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), and mourned deeply alongside her when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly of a heart attack. Confronted with the prospect of total blindness, Marilla was spared selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chose to forgo her college scholarship to stay home and care for her. To ease their household management and allow [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to attend college later, Marilla invited the widowed [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and took in two orphaned distant relatives, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith. She eventually saw [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), attended their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), and stayed by Anne's side to offer support when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gave birth to her first child.

## Quotes

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

> "and I can’t prevent her, for her father aids and abets her. She’s always poring over a book. I’m glad she has the prospect of a playmate—perhaps it will take her more out-of-doors."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

> “I’ll go and have another look,” said Marilla, determining to be just. “If you put that brooch back it’s there still. If it isn’t I’ll know you didn’t, that’s all!”

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla initially takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in by mistake expecting a boy, but after seeing the child's distress at not being wanted and refusing to let her go to a harsh home, she decides to keep and raise her [S1, S2, S3]. Though Marilla constantly works to instruct [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in manners, neatness, and proper prayers, their connection grows into a deep bond of friendship and adoptive motherhood [R1, R2, S4, S5]. Over time, Marilla comes to feel intense warm affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) despite her dramatic outbursts and daydreams, and the two comfort each other as family through major losses [S5, S7, S11].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +24 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are close friends, neighbors, and tea companions who even travel together to a political mass meeting [R5, R6, S9]. While Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) freely offers warnings and advice regarding Marilla's household decisions, Marilla relies on her counsel when managing Anne's upbringing [S9, S12]. Despite occasional friction caused by Mrs. Lynde's blunt comments, the two women maintain a strong and supportive relationship [S10, S11, S12].

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla acts as a guardian to [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) after bringing him to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), placing her in a position to command and discipline him [R7, S15].
